explanation: This is 0 at every D1 and GO step, and at almost every D2 step. It fires about 8-10 only at the D2 of a trial where the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common route right after a trial in which a2 had led rarely to S1 with no reward, and this happens mainly around trials 60-72 of the episode (the same pattern gives about 0-2 early or late in the episode, e.g. trials 20, 83, 99).
